title: Integrality of the Stein global-sections algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put $B=H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and let $A\to B$ be the induced ring map in the Stein factorization [def-weil-pbc-stein-factorization]. Then $A\to B$ is integral: every element of $B$ satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $A$.
